name: Source-aware Soxhlet extraction benchmark
description: This deposit is a versioned snapshot of the data and computational materials accompanying the manuscript 'Source-aware classification of reported biomass extraction yields: a Soxhlet development benchmark'. It contains 197 literature condition-yield records compiled from 22 publications and five feedstocks, source-reference mappings, Python code, fixed evaluation settings, reference predictions, and saved results. These records are compiled from published studies, not 197 newly performed laboratory experiments. Bibliographic attribution is retained in the input data and source inventory. The executable workflow reproduces the eleven-method comparison in Table 6 and Figure 2. Evaluation uses eleven publication holdouts, five calibration measurements per held-out publication, and fifteen random seeds. The package includes instructions and dependency versions in README.md and requirements.txt. This deposit does not claim to reproduce every analysis or figure in the manuscript. The five separate spent-coffee-ground laboratory measurements and their 27-condition experimental design are not included in this snapshot. The corresponding GitHub snapshot is https://github.com/XiyuanLYU/source-aware-soxhlet-benchmark/tree/v1.0.0. Original source publications retain their respective rights, and source article PDFs are not redistributed. This snapshot is provided for public download without granting an additional open-source or data-reuse license; see RIGHTS.md in the archive.
